propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria are dropped at five critical seams: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission.
The four-pass code-review system must thread project criteria through all seams while preserving the 13 built-in packaged criteria and their default resolution contract.
Repository-effective Pass-3 routing and logical-id attribution must be implemented for project criteria to execute once in Round A with retained identity.
The eval/calibration API and CLI must admit active project code-review criteria while rejecting inactive or ambiguous project identifiers.
Project criterion runtime contract and extension requirements must be documented in the LLM framework specification.
Live Gerrit integration must validate that project criteria execute with correct routing thresholds, no blocking directives, and clean findings in advisory-only mode.
